title: Data Breach
briefing: A stolen email password was used to export a customer contact list of 8,400 people (names, emails, delivery addresses). A customer has seen it advertised online.
You join the response as Risk Team Lead.

evidence.title: What was taken
evidence.body: 8,400 customer contacts. No payment data. The account had no multi-factor login.

evidence.title: Legal duty
evidence.body: Notify the data protection regulator within 72 hours of becoming aware if there is risk to individuals; notify individuals if the risk is high.

options.label: Yes, within 72 hours, with what is known and what is still being investigated
options.feedback: The duty applies; partial information is acceptable and expected.

options.label: Only once the investigation is complete
No: no payment data was taken
options.feedback: Addresses and emails still create risk (phishing, fraud).

options.label: Yes: what happened, what was taken, how to spot phishing using their data, and a contact point
options.feedback: Gives people what they need to protect themselves.

options.label: No: it would damage the brand
options.feedback: Hiding it does more damage when it emerges.

options.label: Only if lawyers insist
options.feedback: Leads with self-protection, not customer protection.

options.label: Password-only access to email: MFA for all staff would have stopped the login
options.feedback: The gap identified earlier, now realised.

options.label: Staff need phishing training
options.feedback: Helps, but the control gap is MFA.

options.label: A better firewall
options.feedback: The attacker logged in with valid credentials.

options.label: "Someone used a stolen password to copy names, emails and addresses of 8,400 customers. No payment data was involved. We have reported it, secured the account and are adding stronger login checks. Here is how to protect yourself."
"We were the victim of a sophisticated attack."
options.feedback: A stolen password is not sophisticated.

lesson: A data breach tests honesty and speed: meet the legal clock, help the people affected, and fix the control that let it happen.
